observations: Two photos show a large flat-screen LG TV mounted/placed against a marble-pattern wall.
Photo 0 shows the TV home screen with the webOS interface visible.
Photo 0 shows a thin bezel and a soundbar/speaker-like device on the stand (and a small box/console under the TV).
Photo 1 shows a landscape/sea content screen; no model number or label is visible.
No screen-on close-up shows the exact model number; no back/ports/serial label is visible.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the LG webOS home screen branding/icons consistent with an LG TV.
Photos show a large TV but there is no readable size reference (no tape/measure, no model label, no scale object with known dimensions).
No photo shows the model number/label (on the back, side, or in a settings/about screen).
The content looks high-resolution, but there is no settings/about screen or spec label confirming UHD 4K for this exact model.
webOS is visible (Photo 0), but the specific 'AI' features and 'advanced' claims are not verifiable from the photos.

risks.risk: Exact model/size mismatch (the seller may be quoting a different LG 86-inch model or a different year/series).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the TV's model/serial label (back sticker) OR Settings → General → About this TV showing model number and screen size.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic large LG smart TV with unknown exact model/series (worst-case within the shown category).

risks.risk: Panel condition issues not visible in these photos (dead pixels, backlight uniformity, burn-in, lines).
risks.proof: Short video showing: full-screen solid colors (red/green/blue/white/black) and a grid test pattern, plus close-ups of any dark/bright corners.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed perfect display (worst-case: assume possible panel defects until tested).

risks.risk: Remote/control and ports functionality (HDMI/USB/Wi‑Fi) may be missing or faulty.
risks.proof: Photo of included accessories (remote, power cable) and a video test switching inputs across HDMI ports and opening apps via Wi‑Fi.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'basic functionality only' (worst-case: assume remote/ports may be incomplete until proven).

risks.risk: Soundbar/stand/extra devices shown may not be included, or may be separate from the TV.
risks.proof: A photo listing what is included (TV only vs TV + stand + soundbar + set-top box) with items clearly visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as TV only (worst-case: exclude extras unless confirmed).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the back label showing exact model number (LG 86UA85006LA or otherwise) and serial.
Settings → General → About this TV screenshot showing model, screen size, and software version.
Video test: solid color screens + grid + scrolling text to check dead pixels/lines/backlight.
Photo of included items (remote, stand, power cable) and a quick HDMI input test video.
response.reason: LG is visible, but the exact model number and 86-inch size (which determine the correct market price) are not readable in the photos. Panel/port/remote condition also can’t be confirmed remotely from these two images, so pricing without proof would be unreliable.
